rows.note: This is the all-purpose Hong Kong Cantonese term for an ATM.

example.english: I used the automated teller to withdraw money.
example.jyutping: ngo5 heoi3 tai4 fun2 gei1 lo2 cin2

rows.note: Use this for a bank employee who handles customers' deposits and withdrawals.

example.english: The bank teller asked me to fill in this form.
example.traditional: 銀行櫃員叫我填呢張表。
example.jyutping: ngan4 hong4 gwai6 jyun4 giu3 ngo5 tin4 ni1 zoeng1 biu2

rows.note: Use this straightforward noun phrase for a person whose role or habit is telling stories.

example.english: That person is a great teller of stories.
example.traditional: 嗰個講故事嘅人講得好生動。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 gong2 gu3 si6 ge3 jan4 gong2 dak1 hou2 sang1 dung6

rows.note: Use this official term for the person assigned to count votes in an election.

example.english: During the election, the teller has to check every ballot.
example.traditional: 選舉期間，點票員要逐張核對選票。
example.jyutping: syun2 geoi2 kei4 gaan1 dim2 piu3 jyun4 jiu3 zuk6 zoeng1 hat6 deoi3 syun2 piu3
